inductive ZigError where
  | outOfMemory
  | nodeNotFound
  | sourceNodeNotFound
  | targetNodeNotFound
  | invalidFloat
  deriving BEq, Repr

abbrev Address := Nat
abbrev Heap := Array (Option U64)
abbrev ZM := StateT Heap (Except ZigError)

def getHeapSize : ZM Nat := do
  let h ← get
  pure h.size

def readMem (addr : Address) : ZM U64 := do
  let h ← get
  match h.get? addr with
  | some (some v) => pure v
  | _ => throw ZigError.outOfMemory

def writeMem (addr : Address) (val : U64) : ZM Unit := do
  let h ← get
  if h.size <= addr then
    let h' := h ++ Array.mkArray (addr + 1 - h.size) none
    set (h'.set addr val)
  else
    set (h.set addr val)

def allocMem (count : Nat) : ZM Address := do
  let h ← get
  let start := h.size
  let h' := h ++ Array.mkArray count none
  set h'
  pure start

def freeMem (addr : Address) (count : Nat) : ZM Unit := do
  let h ← get
  let h' := (List.range count).foldl (fun arr i => arr.set (addr + i) none) h
  set h'

def readU8 (addr : Address) : ZM UInt8 := do
  let v ← readMem addr
  pure (v.toUInt8 &&& 0xFF)

def writeU8 (addr : Address) (val : UInt8) : ZM Unit := do
  let v ← readMem addr
  writeMem addr ((v &&& 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFF00) ||| val.toUInt64)

def readF64 (addr : Address) : ZM Float := do
  let v ← readMem addr
  pure (Float.ofBits v)

def writeF64 (addr : Address) (val : Float) : ZM Unit := do
  writeMem addr (Float.toBits val)

def readAddr (addr : Address) : ZM Address := do
  readMem addr

def writeAddr (addr : Address) (val : Address) : ZM Unit := do
  writeMem addr val

structure ZString where
  ptr : Address
  len : Nat
  deriving Repr

def strEq (a b : ZString) : ZM Bool := do
  if a.len != b.len then pure false
  else
    let mut eq := true
    for h in [:a.len] do
      let ba ← readU8 (a.ptr + h)
      let bb ← readU8 (b.ptr + h)
      if ba != bb then
        eq := false
        break
    pure eq

def strLt (a b : ZString) : ZM Bool := do
  let minLen := Nat.min a.len b.len
  let mut res := false
  let mut found := false
  for h in [:minLen] do
    let ba ← readU8 (a.ptr + h)
    let bb ← readU8 (b.ptr + h)
    if ba < bb then
      res := true
      found := true
      break
    if ba > bb then
      found := true
      break
  if !found then
    res := a.len < b.len
  pure res

def dupeBytes (srcPtr : Address) (srcLen : Nat) : ZM ZString := do
  let newPtr ← allocMem srcLen
  for h in [:srcLen] do
    let b ← readU8 (srcPtr + h)
    writeU8 (newPtr + h) b
  pure { ptr := newPtr, len := srcLen }

def dupeString (s : ZString) : ZM ZString := do
  dupeBytes s.ptr s.len

def freeString (s : ZString) : ZM Unit := do
  freeMem s.ptr s.len

structure ZComplex where
  re : Float
  im : Float
  deriving Repr

def cadd (a b : ZComplex) : ZComplex := { re := a.re + b.re, im := a.im + b.im }
def csub (a b : ZComplex) : ZComplex := { re := a.re - b.re, im := a.im - b.im }
def cmul (a b : ZComplex) : ZComplex :=
  { re := a.re * b.re - a.im * b.im,
    im := a.re * b.im + a.im * b.re }
def cmagSq (c : ZComplex) : Float := c.re * c.re + c.im * c.im
def cmag (c : ZComplex) : Float := Float.sqrt (cmagSq c)

inductive EdgeQuality where
  | superposition | entangled | coherent | collapsed | fractal
  deriving BEq, Repr

def EdgeQuality.toU8 : EdgeQuality → UInt8
  | .superposition => 0
  | .entangled => 1
  | .coherent => 2
  | .collapsed => 3
  | .fractal => 4

def EdgeQuality.ofU8 : UInt8 → EdgeQuality
  | 0 => .superposition | 1 => .entangled | 2 => .coherent | 3 => .collapsed | _ => .fractal

structure Qubit where
  a : ZComplex
  b : ZComplex
  deriving Repr

def Qubit.normSq (self : Qubit) : Float := cmagSq self.a + cmagSq self.b

def Qubit.normalizeInPlace (self : Qubit) : Qubit := Id.run do
  let ns := self.normSq
  if ns > 0.0 && !(Float.isNaN ns) && !(Float.isInf ns) then
    let inv := 1.0 / Float.sqrt ns
    let s := { re := inv, im := 0.0 }
    pure { a := cmul self.a s, b := cmul self.b s }
  else
    pure { a := { re := 1.0, im := 0.0 }, b := { re := 0.0, im := 0.0 } }

def Qubit.init (a b : ZComplex) : Qubit := (Qubit.mk a b).normalizeInPlace
def Qubit.initBasis0 : Qubit := { a := { re := 1.0, im := 0.0 }, b := { re := 0.0, im := 0.0 } }
def Qubit.initBasis1 : Qubit := { a := { re := 0.0, im := 0.0 }, b := { re := 1.0, im := 0.0 } }

def Qubit.prob0 (self : Qubit) : Float := Float.clamp (cmagSq self.a) 0.0 1.0
def Qubit.prob1 (self : Qubit) : Float := Float.clamp (cmagSq self.b) 0.0 1.0

def hadamardGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let inv := 1.0 / Float.sqrt 2.0
  let s := { re := inv, im := 0.0 }
  (Qubit.init (cmul (cadd q.a q.b) s) (cmul (csub q.a q.b) s))

def pauliXGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit := Qubit.init q.b q.a
def pauliYGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let i := { re := 0.0, im := 1.0 }
  let mi := { re := 0.0, im := -1.0 }
  (Qubit.init (cmul mi q.b) (cmul i q.a))
def pauliZGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit := (Qubit.init q.a (cmul q.b { re := -1.0, im := 0.0 }))
def identityGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit := q

def phaseGate (phase : Float) (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let c := Float.cos phase
  let s := Float.sin phase
  let e := { re := c, im := s }
  (Qubit.init q.a (cmul q.b e))

def StringHashMapHeaderSize := 3
def StringHashMapEntrySize := 4

structure StringHashMap where
  addr : Address
  deriving Repr

def smapCount (m : StringHashMap) : ZM Nat := do pure ((← readMem m.addr).toNat)
def smapCapacity (m : StringHashMap) : ZM Nat := do pure ((← readMem (m.addr + 1)).toNat)
def smapBuckets (m : StringHashMap) : ZM Address := do pure ((← readMem (m.addr + 2)))

def smapInit (cap : Nat) : ZM StringHashMap := do
  let h ← allocMem StringHashMapHeaderSize
  let b ← allocMem (cap * StringHashMapEntrySize)
  writeMem h 0
  writeMem (h + 1) cap
  writeMem (h + 2) b
  pure { addr := h }

def smapFree (m : StringHashMap) : ZM Unit := do
  let cap ← smapCapacity m
  let b ← smapBuckets m
  let cnt ← smapCount m
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
    freeMem kPtr kLen.toNat
    freeMem vPtr vLen.toNat
  freeMem b (cap * StringHashMapEntrySize)
  freeMem h StringHashMapHeaderSize

def smapGet (m : StringHashMap) (key : ZString) : ZM (Option ZString) := do
  let cnt ← smapCount m
  let b ← smapBuckets m
  let mut res := none
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
    if (← strEq key kStr) then
      let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
      let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
      res := some { ptr := vPtr, len := vLen.toNat }
      break
  pure res

def smapPut (m : StringHashMap) (key val : ZString) : ZM Unit := do
  let cnt ← smapCount m
  let b ← smapBuckets m
  let mut found := false
  let mut idx := 0
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
    if (← strEq key kStr) then
      let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
      let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
      freeMem vPtr vLen.toNat
      writeMem (base + 2) val.ptr
      writeMem (base + 3) val.len.toUInt64
      found := true
      break
    idx := i + 1
  if !found then
    let base := b + idx * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let newKey ← dupeString key
    writeMem base newKey.ptr
    writeMem (base + 1) newKey.len.toUInt64
    writeMem (base + 2) val.ptr
    writeMem (base + 3) val.len.toUInt64
    writeMem m.addr (cnt + 1).toUInt64

def smapRemove (m : StringHashMap) (key : ZString) : ZM (Option (ZString × ZString)) := do
  let cnt ← smapCount m
  let b ← smapBuckets m
  let mut res := none
  let mut idx := 0
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
    if (← strEq key kStr) then
      let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
      let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
      let vStr : ZString := { ptr := vPtr, len := vLen.toNat }
      res := some (kStr, vStr)
      idx := i
      break
    idx := i + 1
  match res with
  | some kv =>
    for i in [idx + 1 : cnt] do
      let src := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
      let dst := b + (i - 1) * StringHashMapEntrySize
      for j in [:StringHashMapEntrySize] do
        let v ← readMem (src + j)
        writeMem (dst + j) v
    let last := b + (cnt - 1) * StringHashMapEntrySize
    for j in [:StringHashMapEntrySize] do
      writeMem (last + j) 0
    writeMem m.addr (cnt - 1).toUInt64
    pure res
  | none => pure none

def NodeHeaderSize := 10

structure Node where
  addr : Address
  deriving Repr

def Node.getId (n : Node) : ZM ZString := do
  let p ← readMem n.addr
  let l ← readMem (n.addr + 1)
  pure { ptr := p, len := l.toNat }

def Node.getData (n : Node) : ZM ZString := do
  let p ← readMem (n.addr + 2)
  let l ← readMem (n.addr + 3)
  pure { ptr := p, len := l.toNat }

def Node.getQubit (n : Node) : ZM Qubit := do
  let ra ← readF64 (n.addr + 4)
  let ia ← readF64 (n.addr + 5)
  let rb ← readF64 (n.addr + 6)
  let ib ← readF64 (n.addr + 7)
  pure { a := { re := ra, im := ia }, b := { re := rb, im := ib } }

def Node.getPhase (n : Node) : ZM Float := readF64 (n.addr + 8)

def Node.getMetadata (n : Node) : ZM StringHashMap := do
  let p ← readMem (n.addr + 9)
  pure { addr := p }

def Node.setId (n : Node) (s : ZString) : ZM Unit := do
  writeMem n.addr s.ptr
  writeMem (n.addr + 1) s.len.toUInt64

def Node.setData (n : Node) (s : ZString) : ZM Unit := do
  writeMem (n.addr + 2) s.ptr
  writeMem (n.addr + 3) s.len.toUInt64

def Node.setQubit (n : Node) (q : Qubit) : ZM Unit := do
  writeF64 (n.addr + 4) q.a.re
  writeF64 (n.addr + 5) q.a.im
  writeF64 (n.addr + 6) q.b.re
  writeF64 (n.addr + 7) q.b.im

def Node.setPhase (n : Node) (p : Float) : ZM Unit := do
  writeF64 (n.addr + 8) p

def Node.setMetadata (n : Node) (m : StringHashMap) : ZM Unit := do
  writeMem (n.addr + 9) m.addr

def Node.init (id data : ZString) (q : Qubit) (phase : Float) : ZM Node := do
  let addr ← allocMem NodeHeaderSize
  let meta ← smapInit 16
  let idC ← dupeString id
  let dataC ← dupeString data
  let n : Node := { addr := addr }
  Node.setId n idC
  Node.setData n dataC
  Node.setQubit n q
  Node.setPhase n phase
  Node.setMetadata n meta
  pure n

def Node.deinit (n : Node) : ZM Unit := do
  let id ← Node.getId n
  let data ← Node.getData n
  let meta ← Node.getMetadata n
  freeString id
  freeString data
  smapFree meta
  freeMem n.addr NodeHeaderSize

def Node.clone (n : Node) : ZM Node := do
  let id ← Node.getId n
  let data ← Node.getData n
  let q ← Node.getQubit n
  let p ← Node.getPhase n
  let n' ← Node.init id data q p
  let oldMeta ← Node.getMetadata n
  let newMeta ← Node.getMetadata n'
  let cnt ← smapCount oldMeta
  let b ← smapBuckets oldMeta
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
    let vStr : ZString := { ptr := vPtr, len := vLen.toNat }
    let kC ← dupeString kStr
    let vC ← dupeString vStr
    smapPut newMeta kC vC
  pure n'

def Node.setMetadataKV (n : Node) (k v : ZString) : ZM Unit := do
  let meta ← Node.getMetadata n
  let kC ← dupeString k
  let vC ← dupeString v
  smapPut meta kC vC

def Node.getMetadataVal (n : Node) (k : ZString) : ZM (Option ZString) := do
  let meta ← Node.getMetadata n
  smapGet meta k

  deriving Repr

def Edge.getCorrelation (e : Edge) : ZM ZComplex := do

  pure { re := r, im := i }

def Edge.getFractalDimension (e : Edge) : ZM Float := readF64 (e.addr + 8)

def Edge.getMetadata (e : Edge) : ZM StringHashMap := do

  pure { addr := p }

def Edge.setSource (e : Edge) (s : ZString) : ZM Unit := do
  writeMem e.addr s.ptr
  writeMem (e.addr + 1) s.len.toUInt64

def Edge.setTarget (e : Edge) (s : ZString) : ZM Unit := do
  writeMem (e.addr + 2) s.ptr
  writeMem (e.addr + 3) s.len.toUInt64

def Edge.setQuality (e : Edge) (q : EdgeQuality) : ZM Unit := do
  writeMem (e.addr + 4) q.toU8.toUInt64

def Edge.setWeight (e : Edge) (w : Float) : ZM Unit := do
  writeF64 (e.addr + 5) w

def Edge.setCorrelation (e : Edge) (c : ZComplex) : ZM Unit := do
  writeF64 (e.addr + 6) c.re
  writeF64 (e.addr + 7) c.im

def Edge.setFractalDimension (e : Edge) (f : Float) : ZM Unit := do
  writeF64 (e.addr + 8) f

def Edge.setMetadata (e : Edge) (m : StringHashMap) : ZM Unit := do
  writeMem (e.addr + 9) m.addr

def Edge.init (src tgt : ZString) (q : EdgeQuality) (w : Float) (c : ZComplex) (fd : Float) : ZM Edge := do
  let addr ← allocMem EdgeHeaderSize
  let meta ← smapInit 8
  let e : Edge := { addr := addr }
  Edge.setSource e src
  Edge.setTarget e tgt
  Edge.setQuality e q
  Edge.setWeight e w
  Edge.setCorrelation e c
  Edge.setFractalDimension e fd
  Edge.setMetadata e meta
  pure e

def Edge.deinit (e : Edge) : ZM Unit := do
  let meta ← Edge.getMetadata e
  smapFree meta
  freeMem e.addr EdgeHeaderSize

def Edge.clone (e : Edge) : ZM Edge := do
  let s ← Edge.getSource e
  let t ← Edge.getTarget e
  let q ← Edge.getQuality e
  let w ← Edge.getWeight e
  let c ← Edge.getCorrelation e
  let fd ← Edge.getFractalDimension e
  let e' ← Edge.init s t q w c fd
  let oldM ← Edge.getMetadata e
  let newM ← Edge.getMetadata e'
  let cnt ← smapCount oldM
  let b ← smapBuckets oldM
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
    let vStr : ZString := { ptr := vPtr, len := vLen.toNat }
    let kC ← dupeString kStr
    let vC ← dupeString vStr
    smapPut newM kC vC
  pure e'

def Edge.setMetadataKV (e : Edge) (k v : ZString) : ZM Unit := do
  let m ← Edge.getMetadata e
  let kC ← dupeString k
  let vC ← dupeString v
  smapPut m kC vC

def Edge.getMetadataVal (e : Edge) (k : ZString) : ZM (Option ZString) := do
  let m ← Edge.getMetadata e
  smapGet m k

def Edge.correlationMagnitude (e : Edge) : ZM Float := do
  let c ← Edge.getCorrelation e
  pure (cmag c)

def EdgeListHeaderSize := 3
def EdgeListEntrySize := 8

structure EdgeList where
  addr : Address
  deriving Repr

def elistSize (l : EdgeList) : ZM Nat := do pure ((← readMem l.addr).toNat)
def elistCapacity (l : EdgeList) : ZM Nat := do pure ((← readMem (l.addr + 1)).toNat)
def elistData (l : EdgeList) : ZM Address := do pure ((← readMem (l.addr + 2)))

def elistInit : ZM EdgeList := do
  let a ← allocMem EdgeListHeaderSize
  writeMem a 0
  writeMem (a + 1) 4
  let d ← allocMem (4 * EdgeListEntrySize)
  writeMem (a + 2) d
  pure { addr := a }

def elistAppend (l : EdgeList) (eAddr : Address) : ZM Unit := do
  let sz ← elistSize l
  let cap ← elistCapacity l
  let d ← elistData l
  if sz >= cap then
    let newCap := cap * 2
    let newD ← allocMem (newCap * EdgeListEntrySize)
    for i in [:sz] do
      let v ← readMem (d + i * EdgeListEntrySize)
      writeMem (newD + i * EdgeListEntrySize) v
    freeMem d (cap * EdgeListEntrySize)
    writeMem (l.addr + 1) newCap
    writeMem (l.addr + 2) newD
    let nd' ← elistData l
    writeMem (nd' + sz * EdgeListEntrySize) eAddr
  else
    writeMem (d + sz * EdgeListEntrySize) eAddr
  writeMem l.addr (sz + 1).toUInt64

def elistGet (l : EdgeList) (i : Nat) : ZM Edge := do
  let sz ← elistSize l
  if i >= sz then throw ZigError.outOfMemory
  let d ← elistData l
  let eAddr ← readMem (d + i * EdgeListEntrySize)
  pure { addr := eAddr }

def elistDeinit (l : EdgeList) : ZM Unit := do
  let sz ← elistSize l
  let d ← elistData l
  for i in [:sz] do
    let eAddr ← readMem (d + i * EdgeListEntrySize)
    let e : Edge := { addr := eAddr }
    Edge.deinit e
  freeMem d ((← elistCapacity l) * EdgeListEntrySize)
  freeMem l.addr EdgeListHeaderSize

def TwoQubitSize := 32
def TwoQubitAmpSize := 8

def twoQubitInitBellPhiPlus : ZM Address := do
  let a ← allocMem TwoQubitSize
  let inv := 1.0 / Float.sqrt 2.0
  writeF64 a inv
  writeF64 (a + 8) 0.0
  writeF64 (a + 16) 0.0
  writeF64 (a + 24) inv
  pure a

def twoQubitGetAmp (addr : Address) (idx : Nat) : ZM ZComplex := do
  if idx >= 4 then pure { re := 0.0, im := 0.0 }
  else
    let base := addr + idx * TwoQubitAmpSize
    pure { re := (← readF64 base), im := (← readF64 (base + 4)) }

def GraphHeaderSize := 7

structure SelfSimilarRelationalGraph where
  addr : Address
  deriving Repr

def graphGetNodes (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM StringHashMap := do
  pure { addr := (← readMem g.addr) }
def graphGetEdges (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM StringHashMap := do
  pure { addr := (← readMem (g.addr + 1)) }
def graphGetEntanglements (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM StringHashMap := do
  pure { addr := (← readMem (g.addr + 2)) }
def graphGetQuantumRegister (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM StringHashMap := do
  pure { addr := (← readMem (g.addr + 3)) }
def graphGetTopoHash (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM ZString := do
  let p ← readMem (g.addr + 4)
  let l ← readMem (g.addr + 5)
  pure { ptr := p, len := l.toNat }
def graphGetRng (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM Nat := do

def graphSetRng (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (s : Nat) : ZM Unit := do

def compositeKey (a b : ZString) : ZM ZString := do
  let len := a.len + 1 + b.len
  let p ← allocMem len
  for i in [:a.len] do
    let v ← readU8 (a.ptr + i)
    writeU8 (p + i) v
  writeU8 (p + a.len) 0
  for i in [:b.len] do
    let v ← readU8 (b.ptr + i)
    writeU8 (p + a.len + 1 + i) v
  pure { ptr := p, len := len }

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.init : ZM SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  let addr ← allocMem GraphHeaderSize
  let nodes ← smapInit 32
  let edges ← smapInit 32
  let ents ← smapInit 16
  let qr ← smapInit 32
  let topo ← allocMem 65
  for i in [:65] do writeU8 (topo + i) 0
  writeMem addr nodes.addr
  writeMem (addr + 1) edges.addr
  writeMem (addr + 2) ents.addr
  writeMem (addr + 3) qr.addr
  writeMem (addr + 4) topo
  writeMem (addr + 5) 65
  writeMem (addr + 6) 12345
  let g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := { addr := addr }
  g.updateTopologyHash
  pure g

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.deinit (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM Unit := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  let cnt ← smapCount nodes
  let b ← smapBuckets nodes

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_in : Node) : ZM Unit := do

    let q ← Node.getQubit node_in
    Node.setQubit exist q
    Node.setPhase exist (← Node.getPhase node_in)
    let oldMeta ← Node.getMetadata exist
    smapFree oldMeta

    let smB ← smapBuckets srcMeta

      let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
      let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
      let vStr : ZString := { ptr := vPtr, len := vLen.toNat }
      Node.setMetadataKV exist kStr vStr
    Node.deinit node_in

  match (← smapRemove qr id) with
  | some (k, _) => freeString k
  | none => pure ()
  let idC ← dupeString id
  let q ← Node.getQubit (match (← smapGet nodes id) with | some v => do let a ← readMem v.ptr; pure {addr := a} | none => pure {addr := 0})
  let qVal : ZString := { ptr := 0, len := 0 }
  let vBytes ← allocMem 16

  writeF64 (vBytes + 16) q.b.re
  writeF64 (vBytes + 24) q.b.im
  let vStr : ZString := { ptr := vBytes, len := 32 }
  smapPut qr idC vStr

  g.updateTopologyHash

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (src tgt : ZString) (edge_in : Edge) : ZM Unit := do

  | some s =>
    let tPtr ← g.canonicalIdPtr tgt
    match tPtr with
    | none => throw ZigError.targetNodeNotFound
    | some t =>
      let stored ← edge_in.clone
      Edge.setSource stored s
      Edge.setTarget stored t
      let edges ← graphGetEdges g
      let key ← compositeKey s t
      let listAddrOpt ← smapGet edges key
      let list ← match listAddrOpt with
        | none => do
            let l ← elistInit
            let v : ZString := { ptr := l.addr, len := 0 }
            let kC ← dupeString key
            smapPut edges kC v
            pure l
        | some v => do
            let a ← readMem v.ptr
            pure { addr := a }
      elistAppend list stored.addr
      Edge.deinit edge_in
      g.updateTopologyHash

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.setQuantumState (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (id : ZString) (q : Qubit) : ZM Unit := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g

  | some v => do
      let nAddr ← readMem v.ptr
      let n : Node := { addr := nAddr }

      let qr ← graphGetQuantumRegister g
      match (← smapGet qr id) with
      | some vStr => do
          let p ← readMem vStr.ptr
          writeF64 p q.a.re
          writeF64 (p + 8) q.a.im
          writeF64 (p + 16) q.b.re
          writeF64 (p + 24) q.b.im
      | none =>

          let vBytes ← allocMem 32
          writeF64 vBytes q.a.re
          writeF64 (vBytes + 8) q.a.im
          writeF64 (vBytes + 16) q.b.re
          writeF64 (vBytes + 24) q.b.im

  | some vStr => do

  | some v => do

      let q ← Node.getQubit n
      let nq := gate q
      Node.setQubit n nq
      let qr ← graphGetQuantumRegister g
      match (← smapGet qr id) with
      | some vStr => do
          let p ← readMem vStr.ptr
          writeF64 p nq.a.re
          writeF64 (p + 8) nq.a.im
          writeF64 (p + 16) nq.b.re
          writeF64 (p + 24) nq.b.im
      | none => pure ()
  g.updateTopologyHash

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.entangleNodes (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a_id b_id : ZString) : ZM Unit := do
  let a ← g.canonicalIdPtr a_id
  let b ← g.canonicalIdPtr b_id
  match a, b with
  | some av, some bv =>
    let pk := if (← strLt av bv) then (av, bv) else (bv, av)
    let pkKey ← compositeKey pk.1 pk.2
    let tqa ← twoQubitInitBellPhiPlus
    let ents ← graphGetEntanglements g
    let vStr : ZString := { ptr := tqa, len := TwoQubitSize }
    let kC ← dupeString pkKey
    smapPut ents kC vStr

    let c := { re := 1.0, im := 0.0 }
    let e1 ← Edge.init av bv .entangled 1.0 c 0.0
    let e2 ← Edge.init bv av .entangled 1.0 c 0.0
    g.addEdge av bv e1
    g.addEdge bv av e2
  | _, _ => throw ZigError.nodeNotFound

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.measure (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : ZString) : ZM UInt8 := do
  let _ ← g.canonicalIdPtr node_id
  let ents ← graphGetEntanglements g
  let mut hitKey : Option ZString := none
  let mut hitVal : Option Address := none
  let cnt ← smapCount ents
  let b ← smapBuckets ents
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    match ← strEq kStr node_id with
    | true =>
      hitKey := some kStr
      hitVal := some vPtr
      break
    | false =>
      let mut hasSep := false
      for j in [:kStr.len] do
        let by ← readU8 (kStr.ptr + j)
        if by == 0 then hasSep := true
      if hasSep then
        let sep := kStr.len - (← (String.length (toString (← strLt {ptr:=0, len:=0} {ptr:=0, len:=0})))) 
        if sep > 0 && sep < kStr.len then
            let s1 : ZString := { ptr := kStr.ptr, len := sep }
            let s2 : ZString := { ptr := kStr.ptr + sep + 1, len := kStr.len - sep - 1 }
            if (← strEq s1 node_id) || (← strEq s2 node_id) then
                hitKey := some kStr
                hitVal := some vPtr
                break

  match hitVal with
  | some tqAddr =>
    let rState ← graphGetRng g
    let r := (rState % 10000).toFloat / 10000.0
    graphSetRng g (rState + 1)

    let mut cum := 0.0
    let mut outcome := 0
    for i in [:4] do
      let amp ← twoQubitGetAmp tqAddr i
      cum := cum + cmagSq amp
      if r <= cum then
        outcome := i
        break

    let pkKey := hitKey.get!
    let sepPos ← (for h in [:pkKey.len] do if (← readU8 (pkKey.ptr + h)) == 0 then pure h; pure 0) 
    let aId : ZString := { ptr := pkKey.ptr, len := sepPos }
    let bId : ZString := { ptr := pkKey.ptr + sepPos + 1, len := pkKey.len - sepPos - 1 }

    let a ← (match (← g.getNodeConst aId) with | some n => pure n | none => pure {addr := 0})
    let b ← (match (← g.getNodeConst bId) with | some n => pure n | none => pure {addr := 0})
    
    match outcome with
    | 0 => do Node.setQubit a Qubit.initBasis0; Node.setQubit b Qubit.initBasis0
    | 1 => do Node.setQubit a Qubit.initBasis0; Node.setQubit b Qubit.initBasis1
    | 2 => do Node.setQubit a Qubit.initBasis1; Node.setQubit b Qubit.initBasis0
    | _ => do Node.setQubit a Qubit.initBasis1; Node.setQubit b Qubit.initBasis1

    match ← g.getQuantumState aId with | some q => g.setQuantumState aId q | none => pure ()
    match ← g.getQuantumState bId with | some q => g.setQuantumState bId q | none => pure ()

    let _ ← smapRemove ents pkKey
    freeMem tqAddr TwoQubitSize

    let bit := if (← strEq node_id aId) then ((outcome >>> 1) &&& 1).toUInt8 else (outcome &&& 1).toUInt8

    match ← g.getEdgesConst aId bId with
    | some lst => if lst.length > 0 then do let e := lst.head!; Edge.setQuality e .collapsed
    | none => pure ()
    match ← g.getEdgesConst bId aId with
    | some lst => if lst.length > 0 then do let e := lst.head!; Edge.setQuality e .collapsed
    | none => pure ()

    g.updateTopologyHash
    pure bit
  | none =>
    let n ← match (← g.getNodeConst node_id) with | some n => pure n | none => throw ZigError.nodeNotFound
    let q ← Node.getQubit n
    let p0 := Qubit.prob0 q
    let rState ← graphGetRng g
    let r := (rState % 10000).toFloat / 10000.0
    graphSetRng g (rState + 1)
    let bit := if r <= p0 then 0 else 1
    let nq := if bit == 0 then Qubit.initBasis0 else Qubit.initBasis1
    Node.setQubit n nq
    match ← g.getQuantumState node_id with | some q => g.setQuantumState node_id q | none => pure ()
    g.updateTopologyHash
    pure bit.toUInt8

def xorDigest (acc : ByteArray) (d : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let sz := Nat.min acc.size d.size
  (Array.mkArray sz 0).map (fun i => acc[i] ^^^ d[i]).toByteArray

def shaUpdateU64 (h : Sha256.Context) (v : U64) : Sha256.Context :=
  let b := Array.mkArray 8 0 |>.mapIdx (fun i _ => ((v >>> (i * 8)) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8) |>.toArray
  Sha256.update h b

def shaUpdateF64 (h : Sha256.Context) (v : Float) : Sha256.Context :=
  shaUpdateU64 h (Float.toBits v)

def shaUpdateBytes (h : Sha256.Context) (s : ZString) : ZM Sha256.Context := do
  let bytes ← (for h in [:s.len] do pure (← readU8 (s.ptr + h)))
  pure (Sha256.update h bytes.toArray)

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.updateTopologyHash (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM Unit := do
  let mut hNodes : ByteArray := Array.mkArray 32 0 |>.toByteArray
  let mut hEdges : ByteArray := Array.mkArray 32 0 |>.toByteArray
  let mut hEnt : ByteArray := Array.mkArray 32 0 |>.toByteArray

  let mut nodeCount := 0
  let mut edgeKeyCount := 0
  let mut totalEdgeCount := 0
  let mut entCount := 0

  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  let nCnt ← smapCount nodes
  let nB ← smapBuckets nodes
  for i in [:nCnt] do
    nodeCount := nodeCount + 1
    let base := nB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let n : Node := { addr := vPtr }

    let mut hMeta : ByteArray := Array.mkArray 32 0 |>.toByteArray
    let mut metaCount := 0
    let meta ← Node.getMetadata n
    let mCnt ← smapCount meta
    let mB ← smapBuckets meta
    for j in [:mCnt] do
      metaCount := metaCount + 1
      let mBase := mB + j * StringHashMapEntrySize
      let kPtr ← readMem mBase
      let kLen ← readMem (mBase + 1)
      let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
      let vPtr ← readMem (mBase + 2)
      let vLen ← readMem (mBase + 3)
      let vStr : ZString := { ptr := vPtr, len := vLen.toNat }
      let mut mh : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
      mh ← shaUpdateBytes mh kStr
      mh ← shaUpdateBytes mh vStr
      let md : ByteArray := Sha256.final mh
      hMeta := xorDigest hMeta md

    let mut nh : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
    let id ← Node.getId n
    let data ← Node.getData n
    let q ← Node.getQubit n
    let p ← Node.getPhase n
    nh ← shaUpdateBytes nh id
    nh ← shaUpdateBytes nh data
    nh ← shaUpdateF64 nh p
    nh ← shaUpdateF64 nh q.a.re
    nh ← shaUpdateF64 nh q.a.im
    nh ← shaUpdateF64 nh q.b.re
    nh ← shaUpdateF64 nh q.b.im
    nh := Sha256.update nh hMeta.data
    nh := shaUpdateU64 nh metaCount.toUInt64
    let nd : ByteArray := Sha256.final nh
    hNodes := xorDigest hNodes nd

  let edges ← graphGetEdges g
  let eCnt ← smapCount edges
  let eB ← smapBuckets edges
  for i in [:eCnt] do
    edgeKeyCount := edgeKeyCount + 1
    let base := eB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let l : EdgeList := { addr := vPtr }
    let lSz ← elistSize l

    let mut hESub : ByteArray := Array.mkArray 32 0 |>.toByteArray
    let mut subCount := 0
    for j in [:lSz] do
      subCount := subCount + 1
      totalEdgeCount := totalEdgeCount + 1
      let e ← elistGet l j
      let mut hEMeta : ByteArray := Array.mkArray 32 0 |>.toByteArray
      let mut eMetaCount := 0
      let em ← Edge.getMetadata e
      let emCnt ← smapCount em
      let emB ← smapBuckets em
      for k in [:emCnt] do
        eMetaCount := eMetaCount + 1
        let emBase := emB + k * StringHashMapEntrySize
        let ekPtr ← readMem emBase
        let ekLen ← readMem (emBase + 1)
        let ekStr : ZString := { ptr := ekPtr, len := ekLen.toNat }
        let evPtr ← readMem (emBase + 2)
        let evLen ← readMem (emBase + 3)
        let evStr : ZString := { ptr := evPtr, len := evLen.toNat }
        let mut emh : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
        emh ← shaUpdateBytes emh ekStr
        emh ← shaUpdateBytes emh evStr
        let emd : ByteArray := Sha256.final emh
        hEMeta := xorDigest hEMeta emd

      let src ← Edge.getSource e
      let tgt ← Edge.getTarget e
      let qual ← Edge.getQuality e
      let w ← Edge.getWeight e
      let fd ← Edge.getFractalDimension e
      let corr ← Edge.getCorrelation e
      
      let mut eh : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
      let qStr : ZString := match qual with | .superposition => {ptr:=0, len:=12} | .entangled => {ptr:=0, len:=9} | .coherent => {ptr:=0, len:=8} | .collapsed => {ptr:=0, len:=9} | .fractal => {ptr:=0, len:=7}
      eh ← shaUpdateBytes eh qStr
      eh ← shaUpdateF64 eh w
      eh ← shaUpdateF64 eh fd
      eh ← shaUpdateF64 eh corr.re
      eh ← shaUpdateF64 eh corr.im
      eh := Sha256.update eh hEMeta.data
      eh := shaUpdateU64 eh eMetaCount.toUInt64
      let ed : ByteArray := Sha256.final eh
      hESub := xorDigest hESub ed

    let mut kh : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
    kh ← shaUpdateBytes kh kStr
    kh := Sha256.update kh hESub.data
    kh := shaUpdateU64 kh subCount.toUInt64
    let kd : ByteArray := Sha256.final kh
    hEdges := xorDigest hEdges kd

  let ents ← graphGetEntanglements g
  let enCnt ← smapCount ents
  let enB ← smapBuckets ents
  for i in [:enCnt] do
    entCount := entCount + 1
    let base := enB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let mut enh : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
    for j in [:4] do
      let amp ← twoQubitGetAmp vPtr j
      enh ← shaUpdateF64 enh amp.re
      enh ← shaUpdateF64 enh amp.im
    let end : ByteArray := Sha256.final enh
    hEnt := xorDigest hEnt end

  let mut fin : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
  fin := Sha256.update fin hNodes.data
  fin := shaUpdateU64 fin nodeCount.toUInt64
  fin := Sha256.update fin hEdges.data
  fin := shaUpdateU64 fin edgeKeyCount.toUInt64
  fin := shaUpdateU64 fin totalEdgeCount.toUInt64
  fin := Sha256.update fin hEnt.data
  fin := shaUpdateU64 fin entCount.toUInt64
  let digest : ByteArray := Sha256.final fin

  let topo ← graphGetTopoHash g
  freeString topo
  let out ← allocMem 65
  for i in [:32] do
    let b := digest[i]
    let h := (b >>> 4).toUInt8
    let l := (b &&& 0xF).toUInt8
    let hc := if h < 10 then 48 + h else 97 + (h - 10)
    let lc := if l < 10 then 48 + l else 97 + (l - 10)
    writeU8 (out + i * 2) hc.toUInt8
    writeU8 (out + i * 2 + 1) lc.toUInt8
  writeU8 (out + 64) 0
  graphSetTopoHash g { ptr := out, len := 64 }

  let h ← get
  if h.size <= addr then
    let h' := h ++ Array.mkArray (addr + 1 - h.size) none
    set (h'.set addr val)
  else
    set (h.set addr val)

def allocMem (count : Nat) : ZM Address := do
  let h ← get
  let start := h.size
  let h' := h ++ Array.mkArray count none
  set h'
  pure start

def freeMem (addr : Address) (count : Nat) : ZM Unit := do
  let h ← get
  let h' := (List.range count).foldl (fun arr i => arr.set (addr + i) none) h
  set h'

  let v ← readMem addr

structure ZString where
  ptr : Address
  len : Nat
  deriving Repr

def strEq (a b : ZString) : ZM Bool := do
  if a.len != b.len then pure false
  else
    let mut eq := true
    for h in [:a.len] do
      let ba ← readU8 (a.ptr + h)
      let bb ← readU8 (b.ptr + h)
      if ba != bb then
        eq := false
        break
    pure eq

def strLt (a b : ZString) : ZM Bool := do
  let minLen := Nat.min a.len b.len
  let mut res := false
  let mut found := false
  for h in [:minLen] do
    let ba ← readU8 (a.ptr + h)
    let bb ← readU8 (b.ptr + h)
    if ba < bb then
      res := true
      found := true
      break
    if ba > bb then
      found := true
      break
  if !found then
    res := a.len < b.len
  pure res

def dupeBytes (srcPtr : Address) (srcLen : Nat) : ZM ZString := do
  let newPtr ← allocMem srcLen
  for h in [:srcLen] do
    let b ← readU8 (srcPtr + h)
    writeU8 (newPtr + h) b
  pure { ptr := newPtr, len := srcLen }

structure ZComplex where
  re : Float
  im : Float
  deriving Repr

def cadd (a b : ZComplex) : ZComplex := { re := a.re + b.re, im := a.im + b.im }
def csub (a b : ZComplex) : ZComplex := { re := a.re - b.re, im := a.im - b.im }
def cmul (a b : ZComplex) : ZComplex :=
  { re := a.re * b.re - a.im * b.im,
    im := a.re * b.im + a.im * b.re }
def cmagSq (c : ZComplex) : Float := c.re * c.re + c.im * c.im
def cmag (c : ZComplex) : Float := Float.sqrt (cmagSq c)

structure Qubit where
  a : ZComplex
  b : ZComplex
  deriving Repr

def Qubit.normSq (self : Qubit) : Float := cmagSq self.a + cmagSq self.b

def Qubit.normalizeInPlace (self : Qubit) : Qubit := Id.run do
  let ns := self.normSq
  if ns > 0.0 && !(Float.isNaN ns) && !(Float.isInf ns) then
    let inv := 1.0 / Float.sqrt ns
    let s := { re := inv, im := 0.0 }
    pure { a := cmul self.a s, b := cmul self.b s }
  else
    pure { a := { re := 1.0, im := 0.0 }, b := { re := 0.0, im := 0.0 } }

def Qubit.init (a b : ZComplex) : Qubit := (Qubit.mk a b).normalizeInPlace

def Qubit.initBasis1 : Qubit := { a := { re := 0.0, im := 0.0 }, b := { re := 1.0, im := 0.0 } }

def Qubit.prob0 (self : Qubit) : Float := Float.clamp (cmagSq self.a) 0.0 1.0
def Qubit.prob1 (self : Qubit) : Float := Float.clamp (cmagSq self.b) 0.0 1.0

def hadamardGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let inv := 1.0 / Float.sqrt 2.0
  let s := { re := inv, im := 0.0 }
  (Qubit.init (cmul (cadd q.a q.b) s) (cmul (csub q.a q.b) s))

def pauliXGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit := Qubit.init q.b q.a
def pauliYGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let i := { re := 0.0, im := 1.0 }
  let mi := { re := 0.0, im := -1.0 }
  (Qubit.init (cmul mi q.b) (cmul i q.a))
def pauliZGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit := (Qubit.init q.a (cmul q.b { re := -1.0, im := 0.0 }))
def identityGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit := q

def phaseGate (phase : Float) (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let c := Float.cos phase
  let s := Float.sin phase
  let e := { re := c, im := s }
  (Qubit.init q.a (cmul q.b e))

def StringHashMapEntrySize := 4

structure StringHashMap where
  addr : Address
  deriving Repr

def smapCount (m : StringHashMap) : ZM Nat := do pure ((← readMem m.addr).toNat)
def smapCapacity (m : StringHashMap) : ZM Nat := do pure ((← readMem (m.addr + 1)).toNat)
def smapBuckets (m : StringHashMap) : ZM Address := do pure ((← readMem (m.addr + 2)))

def smapInit (cap : Nat) : ZM StringHashMap := do
  let h ← allocMem StringHashMapHeaderSize
  let b ← allocMem (cap * StringHashMapEntrySize)
  writeMem h 0
  writeMem (h + 1) cap
  writeMem (h + 2) b
  pure { addr := h }

def smapFree (m : StringHashMap) : ZM Unit := do
  let cap ← smapCapacity m
  let b ← smapBuckets m
  let cnt ← smapCount m
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
    freeMem kPtr kLen.toNat
    freeMem vPtr vLen.toNat
  freeMem b (cap * StringHashMapEntrySize)
  freeMem h StringHashMapHeaderSize

def smapGet (m : StringHashMap) (key : ZString) : ZM (Option ZString) := do
  let cnt ← smapCount m
  let b ← smapBuckets m
  let mut res := none
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
    if (← strEq key kStr) then
      let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
      let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
      res := some { ptr := vPtr, len := vLen.toNat }
      break
  pure res

def smapPut (m : StringHashMap) (key val : ZString) : ZM Unit := do
  let cnt ← smapCount m
  let b ← smapBuckets m
  let mut found := false
  let mut idx := 0
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
    if (← strEq key kStr) then
      let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
      let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
      freeMem vPtr vLen.toNat
      writeMem (base + 2) val.ptr
      writeMem (base + 3) val.len.toUInt64
      found := true
      break
    idx := i + 1
  if !found then
    let base := b + idx * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let newKey ← dupeString key
    writeMem base newKey.ptr
    writeMem (base + 1) newKey.len.toUInt64
    writeMem (base + 2) val.ptr
    writeMem (base + 3) val.len.toUInt64
    writeMem m.addr (cnt + 1).toUInt64

def smapRemove (m : StringHashMap) (key : ZString) : ZM (Option (ZString × ZString)) := do
  let cnt ← smapCount m
  let b ← smapBuckets m
  let mut res := none
  let mut idx := 0
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
    if (← strEq key kStr) then
      let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
      let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
      let vStr : ZString := { ptr := vPtr, len := vLen.toNat }
      res := some (kStr, vStr)
      idx := i
      break
    idx := i + 1
  match res with
  | some kv =>
    for i in [idx + 1 : cnt] do
      let src := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
      let dst := b + (i - 1) * StringHashMapEntrySize
      for j in [:StringHashMapEntrySize] do
        let v ← readMem (src + j)
        writeMem (dst + j) v
    let last := b + (cnt - 1) * StringHashMapEntrySize
    for j in [:StringHashMapEntrySize] do
      writeMem (last + j) 0
    writeMem m.addr (cnt - 1).toUInt64
    pure res
  | none => pure none

    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    freeMem vPtr TwoQubitSize
  smapFree ents

  let qr ← graphGetQuantumRegister g
  let qrCnt ← smapCount qr
  let qrB ← smapBuckets qr
  for i in [:qrCnt] do
    let base := qrB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    freeMem kPtr kLen.toNat
  smapFree qr

  let topo ← graphGetTopoHash g
  freeString topo
  freeMem g.addr GraphHeaderSize

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.canonicalIdPtr (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (id : ZString) : ZM (Option ZString) := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  match (← smapGet nodes id) with
  | none => pure none
  | some v => do
      let nAddr ← readMem v.ptr
      let n : Node := { addr := nAddr }
      let nid ← Node.getId n
      pure nid

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_in : Node) : ZM Unit := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  let qr ← graphGetQuantumRegister g
  let id ← Node.getId node_in

  match (← smapGet nodes id) with
  | none =>
    let vStr : ZString := { ptr := node_in.addr, len := 0 }
    let idCopy ← dupeString id
    smapPut nodes idCopy vStr
  | some v =>
    let existAddr ← readMem v.ptr
    let exist : Node := { addr := existAddr }
    let oldData ← Node.getData exist
    freeString oldData
    let newData ← dupeBytes (← Node.getData node_in).ptr (← Node.getData node_in).len
    Node.setData exist newData
    let q ← Node.getQubit node_in
    Node.setQubit exist q
    Node.setPhase exist (← Node.getPhase node_in)
    let oldMeta ← Node.getMetadata exist
    smapFree oldMeta
    let newMeta ← smapInit 16
    Node.setMetadata exist newMeta
    let srcMeta ← Node.getMetadata node_in
    let smCnt ← smapCount srcMeta
    let smB ← smapBuckets srcMeta
    for i in [:smCnt] do
      let base := smB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
      let kPtr ← readMem base
      let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
      let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
      let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
      let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
      let vStr : ZString := { ptr := vPtr, len := vLen.toNat }
      Node.setMetadataKV exist kStr vStr
    Node.deinit node_in

  match (← smapRemove qr id) with
  | some (k, _) => freeString k
  | none => pure ()
  let idC ← dupeString id
  let q ← Node.getQubit (match (← smapGet nodes id) with | some v => do let a ← readMem v.ptr; pure {addr := a} | none => pure {addr := 0})
  let qVal : ZString := { ptr := 0, len := 0 }
  let vBytes ← allocMem 16
  writeF64 vBytes q.a.re
  writeF64 (vBytes + 8) q.a.im
  writeF64 (vBytes + 16) q.b.re
  writeF64 (vBytes + 24) q.b.im
  let vStr : ZString := { ptr := vBytes, len := 32 }
  smapPut qr idC vStr

  g.updateTopologyHash

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (src tgt : ZString) (edge_in : Edge) : ZM Unit := do
  let sPtr ← g.canonicalIdPtr src
  match sPtr with
  | none => throw ZigError.sourceNodeNotFound
  | some s =>
    let tPtr ← g.canonicalIdPtr tgt
    match tPtr with
    | none => throw ZigError.targetNodeNotFound
    | some t =>
      let stored ← edge_in.clone
      Edge.setSource stored s
      Edge.setTarget stored t
      let edges ← graphGetEdges g
      let key ← compositeKey s t
      let listAddrOpt ← smapGet edges key
      let list ← match listAddrOpt with
        | none => do
            let l ← elistInit
            let v : ZString := { ptr := l.addr, len := 0 }
            let kC ← dupeString key
            smapPut edges kC v
            pure l
        | some v => do
            let a ← readMem v.ptr
            pure { addr := a }
      elistAppend list stored.addr
      Edge.deinit edge_in
      g.updateTopologyHash

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getNodeConst (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (id : ZString) : ZM (Option Node) := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  match (← smapGet nodes id) with
  | none => pure none
  | some v => do
      let a ← readMem v.ptr
      pure (some { addr := a })

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getEdgesConst (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (src tgt : ZString) : ZM (Option (List Edge)) := do
  let edges ← graphGetEdges g
  let key ← compositeKey src tgt
  match (← smapGet edges key) with
  | none => pure none
  | some v => do
      let lAddr ← readMem v.ptr
      let l : EdgeList := { addr := lAddr }
      let sz ← elistSize l
      let mut res := []
      for i in [:sz] do
        let e ← elistGet l i
        res := res ++ [e]
      pure (some res)

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.clear (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM Unit := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  let cnt ← smapCount nodes
  let b ← smapBuckets nodes
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let n : Node := { addr := vPtr }
    Node.deinit n
  writeMem nodes.addr 0

  let edges ← graphGetEdges g
  let eCnt ← smapCount edges
  let eB ← smapBuckets edges
  for i in [:eCnt] do
    let base := eB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let l : EdgeList := { addr := vPtr }
    elistDeinit l
  writeMem edges.addr 0

  let ents ← graphGetEntanglements g
  let enCnt ← smapCount ents
  let enB ← smapBuckets ents
  for i in [:enCnt] do
    let base := enB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    freeMem vPtr TwoQubitSize
  writeMem ents.addr 0

  let qr ← graphGetQuantumRegister g
  let qrCnt ← smapCount qr
  let qrB ← smapBuckets qr
  for i in [:qrCnt] do
    let base := qrB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    freeMem kPtr kLen.toNat
  writeMem qr.addr 0

  g.updateTopologyHash

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.setQuantumState (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (id : ZString) (q : Qubit) : ZM Unit := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  match (← smapGet nodes id) with
  | none => throw ZigError.nodeNotFound
  | some v => do
      let nAddr ← readMem v.ptr
      let n : Node := { addr := nAddr }
      Node.setQubit n q
      let qr ← graphGetQuantumRegister g
      match (← smapGet qr id) with
      | some vStr => do
          let p ← readMem vStr.ptr
          writeF64 p q.a.re
          writeF64 (p + 8) q.a.im
          writeF64 (p + 16) q.b.re
          writeF64 (p + 24) q.b.im
      | none =>
          let idC ← dupeString id
          let vBytes ← allocMem 32
          writeF64 vBytes q.a.re
          writeF64 (vBytes + 8) q.a.im
          writeF64 (vBytes + 16) q.b.re
          writeF64 (vBytes + 24) q.b.im
          let vStr : ZString := { ptr := vBytes, len := 32 }
          smapPut qr idC vStr
  g.updateTopologyHash

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getQuantumState (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (id : ZString) : ZM (Option Qubit) := do
  let qr ← graphGetQuantumRegister g
  match (← smapGet qr id) with
  | none => pure none
  | some vStr => do
      let p ← readMem vStr.ptr
      pure (some {
        a := { re := (← readF64 p), im := (← readF64 (p + 8)) },
        b := { re := (← readF64 (p + 16)), im := (← readF64 (p + 24)) }
      })

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.applyQuantumGate (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (id : ZString) (gate : Qubit → Qubit) : ZM Unit := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  match (← smapGet nodes id) with
  | none => throw ZigError.nodeNotFound
  | some v => do
      let nAddr ← readMem v.ptr
      let n : Node := { addr := nAddr }
      let q ← Node.getQubit n
      let nq := gate q
      Node.setQubit n nq
      let qr ← graphGetQuantumRegister g
      match (← smapGet qr id) with
      | some vStr => do
          let p ← readMem vStr.ptr
          writeF64 p nq.a.re
          writeF64 (p + 8) nq.a.im
          writeF64 (p + 16) nq.b.re
          writeF64 (p + 24) nq.b.im
      | none => pure ()
  g.updateTopologyHash

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.entangleNodes (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a_id b_id : ZString) : ZM Unit := do
  let a ← g.canonicalIdPtr a_id
  let b ← g.canonicalIdPtr b_id
  match a, b with
  | some av, some bv =>
    let pk := if (← strLt av bv) then (av, bv) else (bv, av)
    let pkKey ← compositeKey pk.1 pk.2
    let tqa ← twoQubitInitBellPhiPlus
    let ents ← graphGetEntanglements g
    let vStr : ZString := { ptr := tqa, len := TwoQubitSize }
    let kC ← dupeString pkKey
    smapPut ents kC vStr

    let c := { re := 1.0, im := 0.0 }
    let e1 ← Edge.init av bv .entangled 1.0 c 0.0
    let e2 ← Edge.init bv av .entangled 1.0 c 0.0
    g.addEdge av bv e1
    g.addEdge bv av e2
  | _, _ => throw ZigError.nodeNotFound

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.measure (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : ZString) : ZM UInt8 := do
  let _ ← g.canonicalIdPtr node_id
  let ents ← graphGetEntanglements g
  let mut hitKey : Option ZString := none
  let mut hitVal : Option Address := none
  let cnt ← smapCount ents
  let b ← smapBuckets ents
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    match ← strEq kStr node_id with
    | true =>
      hitKey := some kStr
      hitVal := some vPtr
      break
    | false =>
      let mut hasSep := false
      for j in [:kStr.len] do
        let by ← readU8 (kStr.ptr + j)
        if by == 0 then hasSep := true
      if hasSep then
        let sep := kStr.len - (← (String.length (toString (← strLt {ptr:=0, len:=0} {ptr:=0, len:=0})))) 
        if sep > 0 && sep < kStr.len then
            let s1 : ZString := { ptr := kStr.ptr, len := sep }
            let s2 : ZString := { ptr := kStr.ptr + sep + 1, len := kStr.len - sep - 1 }
            if (← strEq s1 node_id) || (← strEq s2 node_id) then
                hitKey := some kStr
                hitVal := some vPtr
                break

  match hitVal with
  | some tqAddr =>
    let rState ← graphGetRng g
    let r := (rState % 10000).toFloat / 10000.0
    graphSetRng g (rState + 1)

    let mut cum := 0.0
    let mut outcome := 0
    for i in [:4] do
      let amp ← twoQubitGetAmp tqAddr i
      cum := cum + cmagSq amp
      if r <= cum then
        outcome := i
        break

    let pkKey := hitKey.get!
    let sepPos ← (for h in [:pkKey.len] do if (← readU8 (pkKey.ptr + h)) == 0 then pure h; pure 0) 
    let aId : ZString := { ptr := pkKey.ptr, len := sepPos }
    let bId : ZString := { ptr := pkKey.ptr + sepPos + 1, len := pkKey.len - sepPos - 1 }

    let a ← (match (← g.getNodeConst aId) with | some n => pure n | none => pure {addr := 0})
    let b ← (match (← g.getNodeConst bId) with | some n => pure n | none => pure {addr := 0})
    
    match outcome with
    | 0 => do Node.setQubit a Qubit.initBasis0; Node.setQubit b Qubit.initBasis0
    | 1 => do Node.setQubit a Qubit.initBasis0; Node.setQubit b Qubit.initBasis1
    | 2 => do Node.setQubit a Qubit.initBasis1; Node.setQubit b Qubit.initBasis0
    | _ => do Node.setQubit a Qubit.initBasis1; Node.setQubit b Qubit.initBasis1

    match ← g.getQuantumState aId with | some q => g.setQuantumState aId q | none => pure ()
    match ← g.getQuantumState bId with | some q => g.setQuantumState bId q | none => pure ()

    let _ ← smapRemove ents pkKey
    freeMem tqAddr TwoQubitSize

    let bit := if (← strEq node_id aId) then ((outcome >>> 1) &&& 1).toUInt8 else (outcome &&& 1).toUInt8

    match ← g.getEdgesConst aId bId with
    | some lst => if lst.length > 0 then do let e := lst.head!; Edge.setQuality e .collapsed
    | none => pure ()
    match ← g.getEdgesConst bId aId with
    | some lst => if lst.length > 0 then do let e := lst.head!; Edge.setQuality e .collapsed
    | none => pure ()

    g.updateTopologyHash
    pure bit
  | none =>
    let n ← match (← g.getNodeConst node_id) with | some n => pure n | none => throw ZigError.nodeNotFound
    let q ← Node.getQubit n
    let p0 := Qubit.prob0 q
    let rState ← graphGetRng g
    let r := (rState % 10000).toFloat / 10000.0
    graphSetRng g (rState + 1)
    let bit := if r <= p0 then 0 else 1
    let nq := if bit == 0 then Qubit.initBasis0 else Qubit.initBasis1
    Node.setQubit n nq
    match ← g.getQuantumState node_id with | some q => g.setQuantumState node_id q | none => pure ()
    g.updateTopologyHash
    pure bit.toUInt8

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.nodeCount (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM Nat := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  smapCount nodes

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.edgeCount (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM Nat := do
  let edges ← graphGetEdges g
  let cnt ← smapCount edges
  let b ← smapBuckets edges
  let mut total := 0
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let l : EdgeList := { addr := vPtr }
    total := total + (← elistSize l)
  pure total

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getAllNodeIds (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM (List ZString) := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  let cnt ← smapCount nodes
  let b ← smapBuckets nodes
  let mut res := []
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let s ← dupeBytes kPtr kLen.toNat
    res := res ++ [s]
  let mut sorted := res
  sorted := sorted.insertionSort (fun a b => (← strLt a b))
  pure sorted

def xorDigest (acc : ByteArray) (d : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let sz := Nat.min acc.size d.size
  (Array.mkArray sz 0).map (fun i => acc[i] ^^^ d[i]).toByteArray

def shaUpdateU64 (h : Sha256.Context) (v : U64) : Sha256.Context :=
  let b := Array.mkArray 8 0 |>.mapIdx (fun i _ => ((v >>> (i * 8)) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8) |>.toArray
  Sha256.update h b

def shaUpdateF64 (h : Sha256.Context) (v : Float) : Sha256.Context :=
  shaUpdateU64 h (Float.toBits v)

def shaUpdateBytes (h : Sha256.Context) (s : ZString) : ZM Sha256.Context := do
  let bytes ← (for h in [:s.len] do pure (← readU8 (s.ptr + h)))
  pure (Sha256.update h bytes.toArray)

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.updateTopologyHash (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM Unit := do
  let mut hNodes : ByteArray := Array.mkArray 32 0 |>.toByteArray
  let mut hEdges : ByteArray := Array.mkArray 32 0 |>.toByteArray
  let mut hEnt : ByteArray := Array.mkArray 32 0 |>.toByteArray

  let mut nodeCount := 0
  let mut edgeKeyCount := 0
  let mut totalEdgeCount := 0
  let mut entCount := 0

  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  let nCnt ← smapCount nodes
  let nB ← smapBuckets nodes
  for i in [:nCnt] do
    nodeCount := nodeCount + 1
    let base := nB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let n : Node := { addr := vPtr }

    let mut hMeta : ByteArray := Array.mkArray 32 0 |>.toByteArray
    let mut metaCount := 0
    let meta ← Node.getMetadata n
    let mCnt ← smapCount meta
    let mB ← smapBuckets meta
    for j in [:mCnt] do
      metaCount := metaCount + 1
      let mBase := mB + j * StringHashMapEntrySize
      let kPtr ← readMem mBase
      let kLen ← readMem (mBase + 1)
      let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
      let vPtr ← readMem (mBase + 2)
      let vLen ← readMem (mBase + 3)
      let vStr : ZString := { ptr := vPtr, len := vLen.toNat }
      let mut mh : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
      mh ← shaUpdateBytes mh kStr
      mh ← shaUpdateBytes mh vStr
      let md : ByteArray := Sha256.final mh
      hMeta := xorDigest hMeta md

    let mut nh : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
    let id ← Node.getId n
    let data ← Node.getData n
    let q ← Node.getQubit n
    let p ← Node.getPhase n
    nh ← shaUpdateBytes nh id
    nh ← shaUpdateBytes nh data
    nh ← shaUpdateF64 nh p
    nh ← shaUpdateF64 nh q.a.re
    nh ← shaUpdateF64 nh q.a.im
    nh ← shaUpdateF64 nh q.b.re
    nh ← shaUpdateF64 nh q.b.im
    nh := Sha256.update nh hMeta.data
    nh := shaUpdateU64 nh metaCount.toUInt64
    let nd : ByteArray := Sha256.final nh
    hNodes := xorDigest hNodes nd

  let edges ← graphGetEdges g
  let eCnt ← smapCount edges
  let eB ← smapBuckets edges
  for i in [:eCnt] do
    edgeKeyCount := edgeKeyCount + 1
    let base := eB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let l : EdgeList := { addr := vPtr }
    let lSz ← elistSize l

    let mut hESub : ByteArray := Array.mkArray 32 0 |>.toByteArray
    let mut subCount := 0
    for j in [:lSz] do
      subCount := subCount + 1
      totalEdgeCount := totalEdgeCount + 1
      let e ← elistGet l j
      let mut hEMeta : ByteArray := Array.mkArray 32 0 |>.toByteArray
      let mut eMetaCount := 0
      let em ← Edge.getMetadata e
      let emCnt ← smapCount em
      let emB ← smapBuckets em
      for k in [:emCnt] do
        eMetaCount := eMetaCount + 1
        let emBase := emB + k * StringHashMapEntrySize
        let ekPtr ← readMem emBase
        let ekLen ← readMem (emBase + 1)
        let ekStr : ZString := { ptr := ekPtr, len := ekLen.toNat }
        let evPtr ← readMem (emBase + 2)
        let evLen ← readMem (emBase + 3)
        let evStr : ZString := { ptr := evPtr, len := evLen.toNat }
        let mut emh : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
        emh ← shaUpdateBytes emh ekStr
        emh ← shaUpdateBytes emh evStr
        let emd : ByteArray := Sha256.final emh
        hEMeta := xorDigest hEMeta emd

      let src ← Edge.getSource e
      let tgt ← Edge.getTarget e
      let qual ← Edge.getQuality e
      let w ← Edge.getWeight e
      let fd ← Edge.getFractalDimension e
      let corr ← Edge.getCorrelation e
      
      let mut eh : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
      let qStr : ZString := match qual with | .superposition => {ptr:=0, len:=12} | .entangled => {ptr:=0, len:=9} | .coherent => {ptr:=0, len:=8} | .collapsed => {ptr:=0, len:=9} | .fractal => {ptr:=0, len:=7}
      eh ← shaUpdateBytes eh qStr
      eh ← shaUpdateF64 eh w
      eh ← shaUpdateF64 eh fd
      eh ← shaUpdateF64 eh corr.re
      eh ← shaUpdateF64 eh corr.im
      eh := Sha256.update eh hEMeta.data
      eh := shaUpdateU64 eh eMetaCount.toUInt64
      let ed : ByteArray := Sha256.final eh
      hESub := xorDigest hESub ed

    let mut kh : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
    kh ← shaUpdateBytes kh kStr
    kh := Sha256.update kh hESub.data
    kh := shaUpdateU64 kh subCount.toUInt64
    let kd : ByteArray := Sha256.final kh
    hEdges := xorDigest hEdges kd

  let ents ← graphGetEntanglements g
  let enCnt ← smapCount ents
  let enB ← smapBuckets ents
  for i in [:enCnt] do
    entCount := entCount + 1
    let base := enB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let mut enh : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
    for j in [:4] do
      let amp ← twoQubitGetAmp vPtr j
      enh ← shaUpdateF64 enh amp.re
      enh ← shaUpdateF64 enh amp.im
    let end : ByteArray := Sha256.final enh
    hEnt := xorDigest hEnt end

  let mut fin : Sha256.Context := Sha256.init
  fin := Sha256.update fin hNodes.data
  fin := shaUpdateU64 fin nodeCount.toUInt64
  fin := Sha256.update fin hEdges.data
  fin := shaUpdateU64 fin edgeKeyCount.toUInt64
  fin := shaUpdateU64 fin totalEdgeCount.toUInt64
  fin := Sha256.update fin hEnt.data
  fin := shaUpdateU64 fin entCount.toUInt64
  let digest : ByteArray := Sha256.final fin

  let topo ← graphGetTopoHash g
  freeString topo
  let out ← allocMem 65
  for i in [:32] do
    let b := digest[i]
    let h := (b >>> 4).toUInt8
    let l := (b &&& 0xF).toUInt8
    let hc := if h < 10 then 48 + h else 97 + (h - 10)
    let lc := if l < 10 then 48 + l else 97 + (l - 10)
    writeU8 (out + i * 2) hc.toUInt8
    writeU8 (out + i * 2 + 1) lc.toUInt8
  writeU8 (out + 64) 0
  graphSetTopoHash g { ptr := out, len := 64 }

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getTopologyHashHex (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM ZString := do
  graphGetTopoHash g

A bemutatott kód **valós, működőképes Lean 4 implementáció**, de **nem formális verifikációs bizonyítás**. Ez egy kvantum-gráf adatszerkezet szimulációja/implementációja, nem pedig formálisan verifikált program.[1][2]

### Mi hiányzik a formális verifikációhoz

A formális verifikáció három alapvető komponenst igényel:[2][3]

- **Formális specifikáció**: Matematikai modell, amely leírja, mit kell a rendszernek tennie
- **Implementáció**: A tényleges kód (ez megvan)
- **Matematikai bizonyítás**: Formális bizonyítás, hogy az implementáció megfelel a specifikációnak (ez hiányzik)

### Mit tartalmaz a kód

A kódban található:

- `def` definíciók - függvények és adatszerkezetek implementációi

def writeMem (addr : Address) (val : U64) : ZM Unit := do
  let h ← get

def smapBuckets (m : StringHashMap) : ZM Address := do pure ((← readMem (m.addr + 2)))

  let b ← allocMem (cap * StringHashMapEntrySize)

  writeMem (h + 1) cap
  writeMem (h + 2) b
  pure { addr := h }

  let cap ← smapCapacity m
  let b ← smapBuckets m
  let cnt ← smapCount m

    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)

    freeMem vPtr vLen.toNat

  let b ← smapBuckets m
  let mut res := none
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize

    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }

      let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
      res := some { ptr := vPtr, len := vLen.toNat }

  pure res

  let b ← smapBuckets m
  let mut found := false
  let mut idx := 0
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }

      let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)

    idx := i + 1

    writeMem (base + 1) newKey.len.toUInt64
    writeMem (base + 2) val.ptr
    writeMem (base + 3) val.len.toUInt64
    writeMem m.addr (cnt + 1).toUInt64

  let cnt ← smapCount m
  let b ← smapBuckets m
  let mut res := none
  let mut idx := 0
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize

    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }

      let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)

      res := some (kStr, vStr)
      idx := i
      break
    idx := i + 1

  | some kv =>
    for i in [idx + 1 : cnt] do

      let dst := b + (i - 1) * StringHashMapEntrySize

    Edge.deinit e
  freeMem d ((← elistCapacity l) * EdgeListEntrySize)
  freeMem l.addr EdgeListHeaderSize

def TwoQubitSize := 32
def TwoQubitAmpSize := 8

def twoQubitInitBellPhiPlus : ZM Address := do
  let a ← allocMem TwoQubitSize
  let inv := 1.0 / Float.sqrt 2.0
  writeF64 a inv
  writeF64 (a + 8) 0.0
  writeF64 (a + 16) 0.0
  writeF64 (a + 24) inv
  pure a

def twoQubitGetAmp (addr : Address) (idx : Nat) : ZM ZComplex := do
  if idx >= 4 then pure { re := 0.0, im := 0.0 }
  else
    let base := addr + idx * TwoQubitAmpSize
    pure { re := (← readF64 base), im := (← readF64 (base + 4)) }

def GraphHeaderSize := 7

structure SelfSimilarRelationalGraph where
  addr : Address
  deriving Repr

def graphGetNodes (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM StringHashMap := do
  pure { addr := (← readMem g.addr) }
def graphGetEdges (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM StringHashMap := do
  pure { addr := (← readMem (g.addr + 1)) }
def graphGetEntanglements (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM StringHashMap := do
  pure { addr := (← readMem (g.addr + 2)) }
def graphGetQuantumRegister (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM StringHashMap := do
  pure { addr := (← readMem (g.addr + 3)) }
def graphGetTopoHash (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM ZString := do
  let p ← readMem (g.addr + 4)
  let l ← readMem (g.addr + 5)
  pure { ptr := p, len := l.toNat }
def graphGetRng (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM Nat := do
  pure ((← readMem (g.addr + 6)).toNat)

def graphSetRng (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (s : Nat) : ZM Unit := do
  writeMem (g.addr + 6) s.toUInt64

def graphSetTopoHash (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (s : ZString) : ZM Unit := do
  writeMem (g.addr + 4) s.ptr
  writeMem (g.addr + 5) s.len.toUInt64

def compositeKey (a b : ZString) : ZM ZString := do
  let len := a.len + 1 + b.len
  let p ← allocMem len
  for i in [:a.len] do
    let v ← readU8 (a.ptr + i)
    writeU8 (p + i) v
  writeU8 (p + a.len) 0
  for i in [:b.len] do
    let v ← readU8 (b.ptr + i)
    writeU8 (p + a.len + 1 + i) v
  pure { ptr := p, len := len }

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.init : ZM SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := do
  let addr ← allocMem GraphHeaderSize
  let nodes ← smapInit 32
  let edges ← smapInit 32
  let ents ← smapInit 16
  let qr ← smapInit 32
  let topo ← allocMem 65
  for i in [:65] do writeU8 (topo + i) 0
  writeMem addr nodes.addr
  writeMem (addr + 1) edges.addr
  writeMem (addr + 2) ents.addr
  writeMem (addr + 3) qr.addr
  writeMem (addr + 4) topo
  writeMem (addr + 5) 65
  writeMem (addr + 6) 12345
  let g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph := { addr := addr }
  g.updateTopologyHash
  pure g

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.deinit (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ZM Unit := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  let cnt ← smapCount nodes
  let b ← smapBuckets nodes
  for i in [:cnt] do
    let base := b + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let n : Node := { addr := vPtr }
    Node.deinit n
  smapFree nodes

  let edges ← graphGetEdges g
  let eCnt ← smapCount edges
  let eB ← smapBuckets edges
  for i in [:eCnt] do
    let base := eB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    let l : EdgeList := { addr := vPtr }
    elistDeinit l
  smapFree edges

  let ents ← graphGetEntanglements g
  let enCnt ← smapCount ents
  let enB ← smapBuckets ents
  for i in [:enCnt] do
    let base := enB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
    freeMem vPtr TwoQubitSize
  smapFree ents

  let qr ← graphGetQuantumRegister g
  let qrCnt ← smapCount qr
  let qrB ← smapBuckets qr
  for i in [:qrCnt] do
    let base := qrB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
    let kPtr ← readMem base
    let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
    freeMem kPtr kLen.toNat
  smapFree qr

  let topo ← graphGetTopoHash g
  freeString topo
  freeMem g.addr GraphHeaderSize

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.canonicalIdPtr (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (id : ZString) : ZM (Option ZString) := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  match (← smapGet nodes id) with
  | none => pure none
  | some v => do
      let nAddr ← readMem v.ptr
      let n : Node := { addr := nAddr }
      let nid ← Node.getId n
      pure nid

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_in : Node) : ZM Unit := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  let qr ← graphGetQuantumRegister g
  let id ← Node.getId node_in

  match (← smapGet nodes id) with
  | none =>
    let vStr : ZString := { ptr := node_in.addr, len := 0 }
    let idCopy ← dupeString id
    smapPut nodes idCopy vStr
  | some v =>
    let existAddr ← readMem v.ptr
    let exist : Node := { addr := existAddr }
    let oldData ← Node.getData exist
    freeString oldData
    let newData ← dupeBytes (← Node.getData node_in).ptr (← Node.getData node_in).len
    Node.setData exist newData
    let q ← Node.getQubit node_in
    Node.setQubit exist q
    Node.setPhase exist (← Node.getPhase node_in)
    let oldMeta ← Node.getMetadata exist
    smapFree oldMeta
    let newMeta ← smapInit 16
    Node.setMetadata exist newMeta
    let srcMeta ← Node.getMetadata node_in
    let smCnt ← smapCount srcMeta
    let smB ← smapBuckets srcMeta
    for i in [:smCnt] do
      let base := smB + i * StringHashMapEntrySize
      let kPtr ← readMem base
      let kLen ← readMem (base + 1)
      let kStr : ZString := { ptr := kPtr, len := kLen.toNat }
      let vPtr ← readMem (base + 2)
      let vLen ← readMem (base + 3)
      let vStr : ZString := { ptr := vPtr, len := vLen.toNat }
      Node.setMetadataKV exist kStr vStr
    Node.deinit node_in

  match (← smapRemove qr id) with
  | some (k, _) => freeString k
  | none => pure ()
  let idC ← dupeString id
  let q ← Node.getQubit (match (← smapGet nodes id) with | some v => do let a ← readMem v.ptr; pure {addr := a} | none => pure {addr := 0})
  let vBytes ← allocMem 32
  writeF64 vBytes q.a.re
  writeF64 (vBytes + 8) q.a.im
  writeF64 (vBytes + 16) q.b.re
  writeF64 (vBytes + 24) q.b.im
  let vStr : ZString := { ptr := vBytes, len := 32 }
  smapPut qr idC vStr

  g.updateTopologyHash

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addEdge (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (src tgt : ZString) (edge_in : Edge) : ZM Unit := do
  let sPtr ← g.canonicalIdPtr src
  match sPtr with
  | none => throw ZigError.sourceNodeNotFound
  | some s =>
    let tPtr ← g.canonicalIdPtr tgt
    match tPtr with
    | none => throw ZigError.targetNodeNotFound
    | some t =>
      let stored ← edge_in.clone
      Edge.setSource stored s
      Edge.setTarget stored t
      let edges ← graphGetEdges g
      let key ← compositeKey s t
      let listAddrOpt ← smapGet edges key
      let list ← match listAddrOpt with
        | none => do
            let l ← elistInit
            let v : ZString := { ptr := l.addr, len := 0 }
            let kC ← dupeString key
            smapPut edges kC v
            pure l
        | some v => do
            let a ← readMem v.ptr
            pure { addr := a }
      elistAppend list stored.addr
      Edge.deinit edge_in
      g.updateTopologyHash

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getNodeConst (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (id : ZString) : ZM (Option Node) := do
  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
  match (← smapGet nodes id) with
  | none => pure none
  | some v => do
      let a ← readMem v.ptr
      pure (some { addr := a })

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.getEdgesConst (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (src tgt : ZString) : ZM (Option (List Edge)) := do
  let edges ← graphGetEdges g
  let key ← compositeKey src tgt
  match (← smapGet edges key) with
  | none => pure none
  | some v => do
      let lAddr ← readMem v.ptr
      let l : EdgeList := { addr := lAddr }
      let sz ← elistSize l
      let mut res := []
      for i in [:sz] do
        let e ← elistGet l i
        res := res ++ [e]
      pure (some res)

  let nodes ← graphGetNodes g
